title: Conversion Window and Credited Nights by Stay Type, Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement
content:
Many guests of a Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement later move into a permanent Larkspur residency. Two figures of each stay type govern the conversion credit: the window after check-out within which a move-in still earns the credit, and the maximum number of nights of the stay credited to the new residency.

| Stay type | Conversion window (calendar days after check-out) | Maximum nights credited on conversion |
|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Trial Stay | 30 | 7 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Standard Care) | 30 | 14 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Enhanced Care) | 30 | 14 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Extensive Care) | 30 | 14 |
| Memory Care Respite Stay | 30 | 14 |
| Post-Hospital Recovery Stay | 30 | 14 |

- The **conversion window** is the number of calendar days after check-out within which a move into a permanent Larkspur residency still earns the conversion credit. It is 30 days for every stay type.
- The **maximum nights credited** is the cap on the nights of the stay credited to the new residency on conversion: 7 nights for the Independent Living Trial Stay and 14 nights for every other stay type.
